name: takumi

takumi: default (raster-backend, woff2, woff, svg-source, image-decoding, rayon, font-face)

notes: Pipeline copied from takumi-cli `takumi pdf` (takumi-cli/src/document.rs:66-110 parse + stylesheet loading, document.rs:136-175 @font-face/image loading loop, takumi-cli/src/pdf.rs:325-372 needs/render): takumi::parse_html with FromHtmlOptions::builder().document(true) (takumi-core/src/html/mod.rs:413), StyleSheet::parse_owned_list_loosy (takumi-core/src/style/selector.rs:1725), takumi_pdf::needs (takumi-pdf/src/lib.rs:255) and takumi_pdf::render (takumi-pdf/src/lib.rs:283) with PdfOptions (takumi-pdf/src/options.rs:374). Paged output: PdfOptions.page = PageOptions { width: W, height: H, margin: PageMargins::uniform(M) } (options.rs:928, options.rs:871). page_rule: author @page size/margin/:first/:left/:right/named pages override PageOptions via PageOptions::with_page_rules (options.rs:1027, 'CSS winning as Chromium preferCSSPageSize'); page-margin boxes (@top-center etc.) are parsed in takumi-core/src/style/page_rule.rs:649. Adapter sets uncovered_text = UncoveredText::Placeholder (options.rs:472) so a character no font covers draws the font's glyph 0 (tofu) instead of failing the whole render (engine default is Error); such characters are reported in diagnostics as missing-character. local_resources: Takumi does no I/O itself; the host must fetch. The adapter reimplements takumi-cli's loader: via ParsedHtml::css_with_links (html/mod.rs:360), @import inlining and url() rewriting to absolute file:// URLs copied verbatim from takumi-cli/src/stylesheet.rs:193-442 (cssparser + encoding_rs, both already in upstream Cargo.lock), , resolved against the document URL (copied from document.rs resolve_image_sources), then the images and @font-face files that takumi_pdf::needs reports (RenderNeeds, takumi-core/src/layout/needs.rs:33-51) are read from disk and passed as PdfOptions.images (ImageSource::from_bytes, takumi-core/src/resources/image.rs:590) and Fonts::load_font_file (takumi-core/src/resources/font/font_face_set.rs:54), repeating until needs reports no new font files, failed ones marked with Fonts::with_failed_font_files (font_face_set.rs:110). Only file: URLs are read; anything else is skipped with a diagnostic. system_fonts=partial: Takumi reads no platform fonts and has no fontconfig ('Takumi loads no system fonts', takumi/src/lib.rs:46, takumi-pdf/src/lib.rs:31). The adapter loads every TrueType/OpenType/TTC file under /usr/share/fonts and /usr/local/share/fonts at startup as system fonts with Fonts::with_system_fonts (takumi-core/src/resources/font.rs:682; install order DejaVu, Liberation, Noto Sans/Serif, Noto CJK, Noto Color Emoji, rest; system fonts serve exact family-name matches and last-resort fallback). Generic families are not mapped by the engine ('A system font joins no generic family'), so the adapter registers, with FontResource::generic_family (font.rs:1357) and Fonts::register (font.rs:709), the Chromium-on-Linux defaults: sans-serif=Liberation Sans (Chromium's Arial via fontconfig metric alias), serif=Liberation Serif, monospace=DejaVu Sans Mono, emoji=Noto Color Emoji (falling back to DejaVu Sans/Serif/Liberation Mono if missing). No fontconfig alias substitution (e.g. Arial->Liberation Sans, Helvetica) beyond that. Takumi's initial font-family is sans-serif (takumi-core/src/style/properties/font_family.rs:86), unlike Chromium's Times New Roman. Startup reads all font bytes (hundreds of MB with Noto CJK), which costs time per render. font_face: @font-face local url() files via the needs/load_font_file loop above; woff/woff2 decoding enabled (takumi features woff, woff2). geometry=false: takumi-core exposes MeasuredNode (takumi-core/src/layout/measure.rs:33) only for the unpaginated raster measure, without element identity, and the paged frame geometry takumi-pdf uses (PageFrame/PageDrawing, takumi-pdf/src/page.rs:44-330, PageOptions::with_page_rules) is pub(crate); reproducing it from takumi-core's public PagedLayout (takumi-core/src/layout/paged_layout.rs:35) would not match the PDF for @page sizes/margins, so the adapter writes {"unsupported":true}. diagnostics=true: RenderNeeds.ignored_declarations (IgnoredDeclaration/IgnoredReason, takumi-core/src/style/ignored.rs; kinds unknown-property, invalid-value, unknown-at-rule, message includes origin), RenderNeeds.missing_characters (missing-character), RenderNeeds.unresolved_families (unresolved-font-family), resource load failures (stylesheet, image, font-face, font), plus every log::warn! record the engine emits (kind log:, e.g. log:takumi::style, log:takumi::font::missing), de-duplicated. javascript=false:
